answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before its attestations count; an unbonded signal is ignored as mere whisper. Running M sybils then costs M separate bonds, so fake identities scale linearly in locked capital instead of being free. When colluding sybils echo an identical vote pattern, detection slashes all those bonds at once. Treat each bond as a jetty: only stake moored on-chain lets an agent reach quorum, forcing an attacker to post real, slashable collateral per identity.
